question.prompt: What homepage URL should runnable web tests open as their first step?

options.label: Use placeholder
options.detail: Author web tests with {{start_url}} as the homepage entry point until an exact URL or variable name is supplied.

options.label: Assume domain only
options.detail: Treat the literal airbnb.co.in domain named in the PRD as sufficient and fill the exact URL during execution.

options.label: Skip runnable tests
options.detail: Do not author runnable web tests until the exact homepage URL is supplied.

content.risk_rationale: Web tests cannot run from an invented entry URL, and the corpus names the homepage domain but not the exact starting URL string.
